text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate (503/524) from routing layer for requests to model 'gptx-compat-v1' starting at 2024-11-15T02:12:01Z. Error rate: 18% over 5m, spike concentrated in us-west and eu-west. Autoscale events + cross-region fallback observed. Paging oncall-anna and eng-sre.

oncall-anna: on it. joining call in 30s. can someone paste the query distribution and error logs?

eng-sre-jordan: looking. quick summary: clients sending retries (exponential backoff not enforced in some SDK versions). routing policy currently set to fallback to nearest-compatible-region + variant. When origin region returns transient 5xx, policy triggers cross-region failover which causes extra load on target region, which then hits its own transient capacity limits and sometimes returns 502-> triggers further fallback. we're seeing retry amplification.

eng-runtime-sam: yeah logs show repeated route hop ids: hop=us-west -> eu-west -> us-west within a single request series. TTL for routing attempts is 3, but client retries are restarting at 0, so server-side failover multiplies traffic.

product-liz: customer impact? should we page account owners?

customer-success-miguel: mgmt ticket from AcmeOps (enterprise) reporting 50% error surface on embeddings endpoints. Several other PMs DM'd support. they're seeing timeouts + token billing confusion.

oncall-anna: thanks. mitigation plan in next 5: 1) disable cross-region fallback for affected model, 2) enforce server-side 429 on rapid retries to encourage client backoff, 3) roll a routing fix to stop bouncing loops, 4) coordinate with infra to add temporary capacity. any objections?

eng-sre-jordan: +1. additionally, we should patch SDKs to return a Retry-After when we 429. also add a short circuit: if a request has already been failed over once, return 503 instead of failing over again.

eng-runtime-sam: I can flip the routing flag now. command: ```sh
redwoodctl config set routing.fallback.enabled false --model gptx-compat-v1 --scope service
```

eng-sre-jordan: deploying a policy change now to short-circuit repeated failovers: ```json
{"routing": {"max_failover_hops": 1, "fail_closed_on_chain": true}}
```

deploy-bot: apply config requested by eng-runtime-sam: routing.fallback.enabled=false for model gptx-compat-v1. change queued, applying to 6 clusters.

deploy-bot: change applied to clusters: us-west-1, eu-west-1, us-east-1. rollout 100% within ~18s.

customer-success-miguel: pinged AcmeOps with update: disabling cross-region fallback temporarily, we will follow up with postmortem. they acknowledged.

eng-sre-jordan: adding rate-limit rule at LB to send 429 for >5 req/s per client for the affected routes. command: ```sh
lbctl rate-limit add --route "/v1/embeddings" --limit 5 --burst 10 --status 429
```

eng-runtime-sam: also invalidated the compatibility mapping for gptx-compat-v1 so routing won't pick a downgraded variant automatically. that should reduce variant-mismatch failovers.

oncall-anna: monitor dashboards pls. I'll keep pager open for next 2 hours then handoff. what's the ETA on customer visible recovery?

eng-sre-jordan: error rate dropped to 6% in us-west and 4% in eu-west within 2 mins of config changes. latency back to baseline for most traffic. keeping watch.

product-liz: flagged this incident for enterprise ops email batch. also need a comms draft if any SLAs hit. Miguel, can you confirm which accounts were impacted?

customer-success-miguel: AcmeOps (high), BetaRetail (med). BetaRetail opened 3 support tickets; I've prioritized AcmeOps.

eng-runtime-sam: quick note: we should add a guard in routing to decrement attempt count for server-triggered failovers vs client retries, and surface hop metadata in trace. I'll open an RFC.

eng-sre-jordan: agreed. for immediate: I've blocked cross-region failover and added 429 rule. please don't re-enable fallback until SDKs patched.

deploy-bot: rollout of 429 rate limits done.

oncall-anna: handing off to day-oncall (eng-sre-kim) at 10:15 PST. I'll leave the pager until handoff completes. followup actions: incident ticket, postmortem owners: eng-sre-jordan (root cause), eng-runtime-sam (routing fix RFC + patch), product-liz (customer comms), customer-success-miguel (account follow-ups).

product-liz: noted. assign PV to eng-sre-jordan and eng-runtime-sam.

eng-sre-jordan: logging final note: root cause appears to be combination of (1) permissive fallback policy that allows multiple hops, (2) client SDKs with insufficient exponential backoff, (3) autoscaler spin-up latency causing transient denials -> amplified by retries. mitigation: temporary disable fallback, rate limits to induce backoff, SDK patch, routing guard. will include timeline in postmortem.

eng-runtime-sam: I'll open the RFC and include rollout plan for safer fallbacks and tracing.

oncall-anna: closing from night shift, handing to kim. if any regression ping me. :thumbsup:
